meta.title: 글래스 노트 No.3
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (글래스 노트 No.3, an eau de parfum (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 글래스 노트 No.3, an eau de parfum (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A dark studio: near-black navy #090B11 to #121620 so glass and chrome have something to shine against; silver #C9D1DC and white light; a faint iridescence (lilac #B9A7FF, aqua #8FE3E8) in the reflections only; the liquid a pale champagne #F2E3C6. The notes scene adds one soft field of colour per note.
rationale.type: Nanum Myeongjo ExtraBold, a Korean serif with fine contrast, set in chrome (an extruded steel edge, a horizon gradient, a passing sheen) for the name and the solid half of the line, and in plain white where the glass has to bend it.
rationale.motion: Slow and expensive: the camera drifts and orbits, the bottle turns, a long strip of light sweeps across the glass; the text behind the bottle drifts so the glass bends it as it passes; the chrome cap comes down and lands with weight. Soft blur-in for the small lines.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 96 BPM in F lydian (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s), pad, bell, glass and piano with light drums; glassy SFX: a chime for the name, swells into the notes, a thud when the cap lands.
rationale.visuals: All code: one WebGL2 raymarcher (signed distance fields) draws the thick bevelled glass, the champagne liquid with its surface, the octagonal chrome cap and a soft floor reflection; the glass reads the 2D layer behind it through refracted rays, one index of refraction per colour. Lettering and the studio are 2D.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a fragrance film is music and light.
